newsitem.title: USA: Ennis Business names Ward president, COO.
newsitem.headline: Ennis Business names Ward president, COO.

text.p: Ennis Business Forms Inc said Wednesday that Nelson Ward was elected president and chief operating officer of the company.
He succeeds Charles Ray, the company said.
Ward was also elected to the board of directors, the company said.

After setting an aggressive growth strategy, a statement from the company said, Ray concluded the position of chief operating officer would be best filled by someone with extensive sales and marketing experience.
The company said Ray will continue as vice president of administration.
